articles.title: Copper CEO Amar Kuchinad departs as search for a buyer enters a fourth month
articles.snippet: Kuchinad, the CEO of cryptocurrency custody firm Copper since 2024, has left the company, according to two people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Ethereum makes quantum resistance a top priority with a 2029 deadline
articles.snippet: The Foundation wants the network protected before a quantum computer capable of breaking today's cryptography could plausibly arrive, and says upcoming upgrades will be judged against that clock.

articles.title: Stablecoins could save South Korean merchants up to $3.8 billion a year, budget office says
articles.snippet: South Korea’s budget office warned that stablecoin adoption could reduce banks' roles as credit intermediaries and potentially destabilize token pegs during mass redemptions.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slips below $78,500 as stocks close lower
articles.snippet: Copper rushed to a new record high amid supply shortages colliding with rising AI-related demand.

articles.title: Bit2Me sets up specialized unit to help law enforcement track down crypto assets
articles.snippet: The unit formalizes past operations, building on 1.5 million euros in seized crypto the exchange processed in 2025 for agencies including Interpol and Europol.
